description: Fork of exp333 (38.34 M, val_bpb @ 8K = 1.6578). Single trade: out_tph_per_layer [64,64,32,32,32,32] -> uniform [64,64,64,64,64,64] (L2-5 doubled). Per-layer out_proj params: L2-5 each 524K -> 1.05M; total 4.19M -> 6.29M; model 38.34 -> ~40.44 M. Tests whether the late-layer out_proj capacity (which the heavy-early schedule sacrificed) is worth +2.10 M params at the tiny scale. exp303 finding was 'heavy-early best' but that was at much larger tph; may differ at tph=64 scale.
